title: Karen Ann Charters
specs: Use of live bait caught before each trip such as Bunker, Herring and Mullet
Great catches of trophy striped bass
Two boats: 32ft Contender with 600 HP and 40ft Downeaster with new power and safety equipment

blurb: Guests fish for striped bass using live bait that the crew catches before each trip. The charters emphasize a unique experience with trophy striped bass. Guests can request to join the crew in catching bunker before the charter.
